Lemma
[metric-expanding local diffeomorphism onto a simply connected manifold]

↗ lem:dc-ch7-3-3 ↗ lem:dc-ch7-3-1-covering-simplyconnected

1. ch7:3.1Let $f:M\to N$ be a smooth local diffeomorphism between Riemannian manifolds which expands the metric ($|df_p(v)|\ge |v|$ for all $p\in M$ and all $v\in T_pM$), let $M$ be complete, and let $N$ be simply connected. Then $f$ is a diffeomorphism.
Proof

↗ lem:dc-ch7-3-3 ↗ lem:dc-ch7-3-1-covering-simplyconnected \sketch The expansion and completeness hypotheses give a covering map by item 2. The simply connected-base lemma makes it bijective, and a bijective local diffeomorphism is a diffeomorphism.

□
